title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12579)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the requirements for mineral insulated thermocouple cables and for mineral insulated thermocouples having one pair of base-metal conductors for general industrial applications. Note — Mineral insulated cables and thermocouples are also available with more than one pair of conductors. 1.2 This standard does not cover the requirements for nuclear primary loop applications for which there are special requirements. 2, TERMINOLOGY 2-0 For the purpose of this standard, the following definitionsj in addition to those given in IS: 1885 (Part 49)-1978* and IS : 7358-1984t shall apply. 2,1 Mineral Insulated Thermocouple Gables — Bendable metal sheathed cables with •Electrotechnical vocabulary; Fart 49 Industrial process measurement and control. tSpeciiication fur thermocouplei {first revision ). compacted metal oxide insulation and one pair of conductors* 2.2 Mineral Insulated Thermocouples — Thermocouples made from mineral insulated thermocouple cables in accordance with scope of this standard. 2.3 Earthed Junction — A measuring junction electrically connected to the metal sheath. 2.4 Unearthed (Insulated) Junction — A measuring junction electrically insulated from the metal sheath. 2.5 Cold-End —Tlie end of the thermocouple remote from the measuring junction. 3, REFERENCE TABLES 3.1 Following Indian Standards shall be applicable for reference tables: IS : 2053-1074 Thermocouple pyrometers {Jirst revision ) IS : 12579 - 1988 IS : 2054-1962 Reference tables for nickel/ chromium-nickel/aluminium thermocouples IS : 2056-1962 Reference tables for copper constantan thermocouples IS : 2057-1962 Reference tables for iron constantan thermocouples IS : 7988-1976 Reference tables for chromelkopal thermocouples IS : 10625-1983 Reference tables for nickel/ chromium-copper/nickel ( chromel-constantan ) thermocouples IS : 12051-1987 Reference tables for nickelchromium-silicon/nickel-silicon ( Nicrosil/ Nisil ) Type N 4. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
